preconditions.description: The number of cities N must be between 2 and 200.
The number of roads M must be between 1 and 50,000.
The prices of gold and silver coins G and S must be between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= N and 1 <= yi <= N and 1 <= gi <= 10**9 and 1 <= si <= 10**9 for xi, yi, gi, si in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect valid cities and have valid gold and silver coin requirements.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(minimal_cost) if minimal_cost is not None else stdout == '<image>'
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal cost of the gift or '<image>' if no valid gift exists.
